title: The Bodyguard
author: Katherine Center
summary: Hannah, a gifted bodyguard, is hired to protect a famous actor and has to pretend to be his assistant. Close quarters and a threat to his safety bring them together.
readIf: you want a warm, funny romance with a competent heroine and a lovable, goofy hero.
skipIf: you prefer serious, high-tension romantic suspense with a gritty edge.
